statement: TechCrunch reports Anthropic will pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years for cloud infrastructure, with the relationship potentially growing to about $20 billion.
why: A seven-year, multi-billion contracted commitment from a frontier lab is hard evidence of long-dated compute demand and of new non-hyperscaler capacity being built to serve it.

impact.mechanism: Contracted spend converts into a capacity build, which pulls through servers, memory and data center space over the life of the agreement.

evidence.excerpt: Anthropic will pay '$11.6 billion over seven years' to Akamai for cloud infrastructure, with the relationship potentially growing to approximately $20 billion total
$150 million to $300 million in 2027, starting in the second half, with revenue reaching an annual pace of about $1.7 billion by the end of 2028

a $11.6 billion contractual commitment over seven years for Anthropic to use Akamai Cloud's distributed AI infrastructure and software, described as supporting Anthropic's accelerating CPU workload demands
The agreement provides for potential expansion of the relationship by up to an additional $9 billion, representing a total potential commitment of approximately $20 billion.

confidence.basis: Secondary press coverage of a company announcement; no filing text read in this document.

dispersion: $11.6B committed; up to about $20B if the relationship expands.
